backend: llama.cpp; Qwen3.5-9B Q4; supplied by root, not the paper model/backend
deviations: Local 9B Q4 model and llama.cpp instead of the paper backbone/server.
Agent context budget 12288 (effective retained target 10240), output 2048, rather than 32768/8192.
Agent timeout 1800 seconds; max_steps 64 and LM-call cap 96 instead of the effectively unlimited ContextBench paper settings.
Thinking disabled through official enable_thinking kwarg for the existing endpoint.
The official R1000 seed42 task, 1000 records and 24 queries are unchanged; original benchmark metadata stays 32768 tokens.
cost_metric=usd avoids an invalid 9B dense-model FLOPs approximation; report token usage and wall time, not a claimed dollar/FLOPs comparison.
CLM_LLM_MAX_RETRIES=1 disables the official transient-error retry loop; litellm num_retries is already 0.
A 2700-second outer supervisor covers the complete Harbor setup/agent/verifier process; timeout cleanup targets only this trial's compose project and process group.
LiteLLM 1.106.2 official mcp extra resolves the released tool-dispatch import dependency; LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True uses the pinned installed backup instead of mutable remote pricing.
